$comment: Text pool for the Hospitalization prayer category.
requests: My dad is in the ICU tonight. Please pray.
Healing for my mom, who was admitted this morning.
Our baby girl is in the NICU. Pray she grows strong.
For my coworker, in the hospital with pneumonia.
Surgery tomorrow at 7 a.m. Asking for peace and steady hands.
My grandpa fell and is in the hospital with a broken hip.
My husband was rushed to the hospital last night with chest pains. They are running tests and keeping him for observation. Pray for answers and for his heart.
Our son was born seven weeks early and is in the NICU. He is so small, but he is a fighter. Pray for his lungs to grow strong and for us as we go back and forth every day.
My mom had a fall at home and broke her hip. She had surgery yesterday and is very confused from the medicine. Pray for a clear mind, healing, and good nurses on every shift.
A friend from work was in a car accident on the freeway this weekend. He is in the ICU but stable. Pray for healing and for his wife, who has barely left his side.
I go in for heart surgery on Tuesday. I am at peace, mostly, but my family is anxious. Pray for the surgical team and for my wife and kids in the waiting room.
Asking for prayer for my grandmother. She has been in the hospital for a week with an infection, and they are still trying to find the right antibiotic.
Our daughter was admitted with a high fever that will not break. She is three. We are exhausted and scared. Please pray for healing and rest for all of us.
My brother was admitted after a bad reaction to a new medication. He is doing better, but they want to keep him a few more days. Pray for full healing and no lasting effects.
My dad is having his knee replaced tomorrow morning. Pray for the surgeon, for no complications, and that he takes it easy afterward. He is not good at taking it easy.
Lifting up a neighbor of ours who has been in the hospital for almost a month. Her kids are staying with relatives. Pray for her healing and for the family to be together again soon.
My wife had an emergency C-section, and she and the baby are both still in the hospital. Pray for her recovery and for the baby to keep improving.
Pray for my uncle, who is on a ventilator in the ICU. The doctors say the next few days are important. Our family is gathering to be with him.
My mother is in the hospital after a stroke. She is awake and knows us, but she cannot speak clearly yet. Pray for her to find her words again and for the therapy ahead.
My son had his appendix out last night. He is doing well, but he is sore and bored. Pray for quick healing so he can get home.
For the nurses taking care of my dad. They have been so kind and patient. Pray for strength for them on long shifts, and for my dad to heal.
My best friend is in labor with her first baby, and things are not going as planned. Pray for her and the baby to be safe and healthy.
I am sitting in a hospital waiting room as I type this. My husband is in surgery. Pray for him, and for me to be calm.
A family from our small group has a teenage son with a concussion from a football game. They are keeping him overnight. Pray for healing and no lasting effects.
My father-in-law has been in and out of the hospital three times this year. He was admitted again yesterday. Pray for real healing this time and for the doctors to find answers.
My coworker's wife is in the ICU after complications from surgery. He has two little kids at home and is trying to be everywhere at once.
Our twins came early and are in the NICU. One is doing great and the other needs more help breathing. Pray for both of them and for my wife as she recovers.
My mom is being moved from the ICU to a regular room today. That is good news, but she has a long way to go. Pray for steady progress and for her spirit to stay strong.
Pray for my grandmother, who was taken to the emergency room after a fall at her care home. They are checking her over carefully. She is 88.
I will be in the hospital for a few days after my surgery on Friday. Pray for good care, a smooth recovery, and for my kids while I am away from them.
Healing and comfort for my aunt, who has been in the hospital since Sunday. She is lonely, and visits are limited. Pray she feels God close.
My husband is a firefighter and was hurt on a call this week. He is in the hospital with injuries to his arms. Pray for healing and for no infection.
Our neighbor's little boy swallowed something he should not have and is in the hospital. He is stable. Pray for a full recovery and for his scared parents.
My grandfather is in the hospital with heart failure. He is tired but still telling jokes to the nurses. Pray for his comfort and for more good days with him.

My mom was admitted to the hospital on Monday with what we thought was the flu. It turned out to be much more serious, and she was moved to the ICU on Wednesday. She is stable now, but the doctors are watching her closely. My sister and I are taking turns staying overnight. Pray for her healing, for the doctors and nurses, and for my sister and me to have strength.

Our daughter was born at 29 weeks and has been in the NICU for three weeks now. She has gained a little weight and is breathing with less help each day. We are so thankful for every small step. Pray for her to keep growing, for no setbacks, and for my husband and me as we split time between the hospital and our two older kids at home.

My dad had a fall last week and hit his head. He is in the hospital and has been sleeping most of the time. The doctors are not sure yet how much he will recover. He has always been the strong one in our family, and it is hard to see him like this. Pray for healing, for his mind to come back to him, and for my mom, who has not left his side.

I have surgery scheduled for next Thursday, and it will be a long one. The recovery is expected to take a few months. I am trusting God, but I am also very aware of everything that could go wrong. Pray for the surgeon and the whole team, for my body to heal well, and for my wife, who will be carrying a lot while I recover.

A dear friend from my Bible study has been in the hospital for nearly two weeks. She went in for a routine procedure and developed complications. She is a widow and does not have family nearby, so several of us are taking turns visiting. Pray for her healing, for her to feel loved and not alone, and for the staff caring for her through the night.

Our son is 17 and was in a car accident on his way home from practice. He has a broken leg and some other injuries, and he will be in the hospital for at least a week. We are so thankful he is alive. Pray for healing, for his friend who was driving and feels terrible, and for our family as we sit with him.
details: The nurses and doctors have been kind, and that means so much.
Pray for the whole family as we try to keep life going at home.
Pray for good rest. Hospitals are not easy places to sleep.
We are trusting God with every hour of this, one at a time.
Good communication between all the doctors involved would be a real gift.
Every small step forward will feel like a gift right now.
Asking that God would be close during the long nights.
We are grateful for the friends who have brought meals and sent texts.
Wisdom for the medical team and clear decisions are needed most right now.
It is a lot to take in, and things change quickly from day to day.
Pray for no infections or setbacks along the way, big or small.
Our hearts need to stay steady, no matter what each day brings.
We feel the prayers of our church family, and they are holding us up.
God has been faithful so far, and we are holding on to that.
Remember the ones who are tired from being strong for everyone else.
answers: Home at last! Thank you for every prayer.
Out of the hospital and resting at home. God is good.
Still in the hospital, but improving every day. Keep praying, please.
The care team is encouraged, and so are we. Thank you for praying with us.
A big step forward this week, and the nurses say things look good.
It has been a long road, but we are finally on the other side of it. Thank you.
Things are stable for now. We are grateful and still trusting God.
Not out of the woods yet, but there is real progress. We feel your prayers.
Discharged yesterday! Recovery will take time, but we are so thankful.
God gave us peace through every long day and night. Thank you for standing with us.
Some setbacks this week, but we are at peace and trusting God's care.
Answered prayer. The staff could not believe how quickly things turned around.
We are home and adjusting. Thank you for the meals and the prayers.
Still waiting for a clear answer, but the care has been excellent and we feel God near.
Every day is a little better. Thank you for standing beside our family.
